newsitem.title: USA: Panda Project Q4 March 31 net loss narrows.
newsitem.headline: Panda Project Q4 March 31 net loss narrows.

text.p: Quarter and Twelve Months Ended March 31, 1997
For the Quarter For the Twelve Months

NOTE: Panda Project Inc said it recognized an additional $300,000 of expected revenue in the fourth quarter of 1997 related to a research grant from the Defense Advanced Research Project Agency which was delayed because the company chose to temporarily delay the completion of certain tasks related to the grant.

Net income for the fourth quarter of 1997 included special charges of approximately $585,000 to reflect the impairment of assets primarily related to excess computer and office equipment resulting from reductions in the company's workforce, a $160,000 charge for the negotiated release of the remainder of excess leased office space at the company's current primary facility and the settlement of litigation for $40,000 in cash and the issuance of 17,500 shares of common stock.
For fiscal 1997, one-time charges primarily associated with the company's refocused corporate structure contributed approximately $2.7 million to reported expenses.
